proposals.text: The hand-authored SVG is the sole authority for geometry and colour; the GPU scene derives from it, never becomes a second author.
proposals.teaches: Keep one hand-authored geometry authority; treat mesh/GPU output as derivation.

proposals.text: Extrusion depth follows the square root of relative area between declared bounds — larger faces advance by measured law, not by eye.
proposals.teaches: Derive intrinsic depth from measured relative area with an explicit sqrt law and bounds.

proposals.text: Smooth the camera, never the pick: hit identity follows raw coordinates through the same transforms the pixels used.
proposals.teaches: Separate camera conditioning from picking so selection agrees with visible depth.

proposals.text: The fixture may assert a count; the engine must not. Facet N lives in the manifest — shaders and skills iterate what the source produced.
proposals.teaches: Keep dual-N honesty: golden fixtures assert counts; portable engines consume dynamic N.

proposals.text: Drive the pose from elapsed time, not frame count, so the same wall-clock second yields the same orientation on a slow machine.
proposals.teaches: Time-base animation on elapsed seconds so choreography stays device-independent.

proposals.text: Before the mesh, ask who owns the audible sample clock — that synchronicity is the first relevance utility. The specimen owns the sample clock; the GPU loop owns elapsed choreography; invent no sample-lock between them.
proposals.teaches: Teach sound-clock ownership as the first honest reason for the stack, without fabricating audio/3D lock.

proposals.text: A merge story cannot be written before a merge exists — public provenance is observed Git history, never anticipatory narrative.
proposals.teaches: Publish only real repository events; leave provenance pending until merge evidence exists.

proposals.text: The aphorism teaches the contract; the finding remains the proof — never retire the evidence because a sentence was proposed.
proposals.teaches: Keep findings and cold reviews in place when distilling animation wisdom into TTOD proposals.

proposals.text: The golden fixture proves the tool; it must not become the tool's business logic.
proposals.teaches: Keep reusable compilers free of fixture-specific product logic.

skippedBecauseAlreadyInTTOD.insight: D32 SVG adapter vs rive-animascript-3d backend separation
skippedBecauseAlreadyInTTOD.reason: Active TTOD already teaches protocol/adapter/port and inner-reusable/outer-disposable; dual-capability split would mostly restate those.
TTOD already covers SVG nature and explicit identity; proposed only the cascade-specific sole-authority and dual-N contracts instead.
